messages.text: Gloucester claim thrilling draw against Champions Cup holders Bordeaux

metadata.summary: Will Trenholm’s brace was not enough to help Gloucester pull off a stunning upset against Champions Cup holders Bordeaux, as they were forced to settle for a 36-36 draw after a dramatic contest.
metadata.content: Champions Cup: Gloucester claim thrilling draw against holders Bordeaux | Rugby Union News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Champions Cup: Gloucester claim thrilling draw against holders Bordeaux Will Trenholm scores a brace of tries as Gloucester fall just short of beating Champions Cup holders Bordeaux in a thrilling 36-36 draw; Edinburgh suffered a 27-17 defeat against Toulon in their Challenge Cup opener Friday 16 October 2026 22:53, UK Image: Will Trenholm celebrates as Gloucester draws with Bordeaux in the Investec Champions Cup Will Trenholm’s brace was not enough to help Gloucester pull off a stunning upset against Champions Cup holders Bordeaux, as they were forced to settle for a 36-36 draw after a dramatic contest. George Skivington's team pushed the French outfit all the way during a pulsating European tie at Kingsholm Stadium. Gloucester held a 24-17 lead at half-time before Trenholm crashed over twice, but a double by Louis Bielle-Biarrey salvaged a share of the spoils for visiting Bordeaux. metadata.content: Daniel Dubois and Fabio Wardley both career heaviest for heavyweight title rematch | 'Definitely not going the distance' | Boxing News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Daniel Dubois and Fabio Wardley both career heaviest for heavyweight title rematch | 'Definitely not going the distance' Daniel Dubois and Fabio Wardley hit the scales for their world championship rematch; Dubois and Wardley both came in at their respective career heaviest weights on Friday; Daniel Dubois defeated Fabio Wardley in a thrilling WBO heavyweight title clash in May John Dennen Sports Journalist @johndennen Friday 16 October 2026 20:04, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Fabio Wardley and Daniel Dubois weigh-in and face off ahead of their heavyweight title clash tomorrow night. Both Daniel Dubois and Fabio Wardley weighed in at a career heaviest for their WBO heavyweight championship rematch. London's Dubois had scaled a career heaviest for their first fight and he topped that at 253.9lbs for Saturday's rematch while Wardley was 248.3lbs. Dubois said that means they're both going for power in this fight. "I'm ready to go, ready for my job," he told Sky Sports . "I'll break him down, break him down. Like last time, but better this time." messages.text: Lions forward Andrews dies suddenly ahead of match in France

metadata.summary: Lions player Hyron Andrews has died suddenly in France, where the team were preparing for a Champions Cup fixture.
metadata.content: Hyron Andrews: South African rugby side Lions confirm sudden death of player ahead of Champions Cup match in France against La Rochelle | Rugby Union News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Hyron Andrews: South African rugby side Lions confirm sudden death of player ahead of Champions Cup match in France against La Rochelle Hyron Andrews died suddenly in France at the age of 31; the Lions say their Champions Cup game on Saturday against La Rochelle will go ahead in honour of the forward; Andrews previously played for English club Sale Sharks Friday 16 October 2026 15:57, UK Image: Hyron Andrews has died aged 31 Lions player Hyron Andrews has died suddenly in France, where the team were preparing for a Champions Cup fixture. A statement from SA rugby said that Andrews "passed away tragically, following an accident" and that he had "died after falling" at the team hotel. Following French media reports that a Lions player had passed away, the Lions released a separate statement in the afternoon that named Andrews. The 31-year-old South African second-row forward had spent the previous two years of his career playing for Sale Sharks in England before returning home this summer to join the Lions. The Lions said Saturday's match against La Rochelle will go ahead "in honour of Hyron". Twitter This content is provided by Twitter , which may be using cookies and other technologies. metadata.summary: Mikel Arteta says Arsenal will take a new team photograph including William Saliba after the defender's surprise absence from the one published this week.
metadata.content: Mikel Arteta says Arsenal plan to take another team photo including William Saliba after defender's omission | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Mikel Arteta says Arsenal plan to take another team photo including William Saliba after defender's omission William Saliba was left out of Arsenal's team photograph for the 2026/27 season earlier this week; Mikel Arteta explained it was taken because of commercial obligations despite defender's absence; club will retake image Nick Wright Football Features Writer @nicholaspwright Friday 16 October 2026 15:26, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Mikel Arteta explains why William Saliba wasn't included in the club's team picture Mikel Arteta says Arsenal will take a new team photograph including William Saliba after the defender's surprise absence from the one published this week. Arsenal supporters were left baffled by Saliba's omission from the official 2026/27 picture as the club revealed he was unavailable to attend due to a medical appointment. Saliba is yet to play this season because of a back injury but the 25-year-old remains a key player, having made 184 appearances for the club, which heightened the intrigue around his omission. "What happened was that we have tried to do that picture three times already and we had to cancel it last minute for different reasons," explained Arteta ahead of Arsenal's away trip to Nottingham Forest, live on Sky Sports on Sunday. messages.text: How Glasner is trying to solve Forest’s scoring problem

metadata.summary: The Premier League’s second-lowest scorers have, unsurprisingly, been working on their finishing in training this week. But when it came to giving advice on scoring goals, head coach Oliver Glasner knew when to hand over to an expert.
metadata.content: Oliver Glasner: How Nottingham Forest head coach is trying to solve club's scoring problem ahead of Arsenal fixture | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Exclusive Oliver Glasner: How Nottingham Forest head coach is trying to solve club's scoring problem ahead of Arsenal fixture Nottingham Forest have only scored five Premier League goals this season and none at home; head coach Oliver Glasner is encouraged by performances despite results; Watch Nottingham Forest vs Arsenal live on Sky Sports Main Event this Sunday, kick-off 4.30pm David Richardson Football Journalist Friday 16 October 2026 22:32, UK Image: Oliver Glasner has only won one of his first seven games in charge of Nottingham Forest The Premier League’s second-lowest scorers have, unsurprisingly, been working on their finishing in training this week. But when it came to giving advice on scoring goals, head coach Oliver Glasner knew when to hand over to an expert. Nottingham Forest have had the third-most shots in the top flight but rank 19th in conversion rate, netting five fewer than their expected goals. Glasner can only tell his squad so much about scoring. "I was explaining to the team what we were going to do," Glasner told Sky Sports . "Chris Wood was standing next to me and I passed the words to him because he has scored almost 200 goals in English football, 92 in the Premier League. "Who can talk more about scoring goals than Chris Wood can? Because I didn't score any goals in the Premier League
